This matches the file's own corrected claim exactly and matches canonical docs I WebFetched this session (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, 2026-08-23): managed-policy CLAUDE.md scope = 'every Claude Code session on the machine, in every repository'; user CLAUDE.md loaded into 'Every session'; and outside a git repo, auto-memory keys to 'the project root... instead' — which is exactly the gap the fix also closed by requiring a NEW, never-reused directory per session ('outside a repo the working directory is the project root, so a reused folder gives session 1 a place to leave something for session 2'). The fixed text does not overclaim in the other direction and is not wrong in some third way — it is accurate. Verdict: FIXED.
